findings.disposition_note: Exempted: the routing guard the node exists to add is carried by the independent assertions at lines 159-164 (exit 0, backend == LOCAL, local is True), which do redden when the preview's call is removed; the route-mode literal is nameable in the dedup node's test rewrite.
findings.exempted_reason: The guard against the regression this node fixes does not rest on this assertion.
findings.text: The route_mode parity assertion compares dry_payload route_mode against real_payload route_mode, and both values come from the same constant helper reckon/crew/dispatch.py:740, so a regression that stopped flagging an overridden hold on both paths at once leaves the assertion true; the literal 'overridden-hold' is never named against an independent source.
